objective: Execute an evidence-backed audit of the declared P1-P6 Astronomical Data Analysis & Discovery Platform scope before release freeze.

baseline.status: v0.5.0-release is published immutable; P1-P6 implementation surfaces exist but require one explicit current-revision audit.

correctness.before: P1-P6 completion was distributed across component evidence
correctness.after: one reproducible workflow exercises the declared P1-P6 contract/integration surfaces

reliability.before: no single pre-freeze product-scope gate existed
reliability.after: a dedicated product-scope gate is executed on every audit PR

reproducibility.before: product-scope evidence was distributed across prior cycles
reproducibility.after: the workflow retains an exact commit/run evidence artifact

root_causes: The audit record is intentionally kept pending until the current-revision audit completes.

findings: Product-scope evidence must be executable and tied to the audited revision.
The lifecycle record itself must satisfy the cumulative lifecycle contract.

open_blockers: Product Scope Audit must pass before the stage is accepted.
